title: Fix DXR global root signature: use descriptor table for UAV t/u bindings
motivation: CreateStateObject fails with: 'Shader is declaring a typed UAV using a register mapped to a root descriptor UAV'. DXR's global root signature cannot map a typed texture UAV via root descriptor. We must bind g_output (u0) via a UAV descriptor table, and g_scene (t0) via an SRV descriptor or SRV table.
deliverables: Global root signature with two descriptor tables: SRV table (t0: TLAS) and UAV table (u0: output texture)
Runtime allocation of SRV (TLAS) and UAV (HDR) descriptors in a shader-visible heap and binding via SetComputeRootDescriptorTable
acceptance: No InfoQueue error about typed UAV root descriptor
PIX capture shows RayGen with descriptor tables bound
implementation: In App::createDXRPipeline, build a root signature with two descriptor tables: one SRV range for t0, one UAV range for u0
Create SRV for TLAS (D3D12_RAYTRACING_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_SRV) as needed; ensure descriptor heap has space
Before DispatchRays, set descriptor heap and root descriptor tables to the allocated SRV/UAV handles
Update SBT build if export names change (they shouldn't)
test_plan: Run Debug; PSO creation should succeed
Capture in PIX; verify no root-signature validation errors
Temporarily remove UAV table to reproduce error, then restore
